ui_bugs.component: Cycle page tab content (Question Bank / Reportees / Submissions)
ui_bugs.issue: Tabs switch correctly but tab CONTENT did not display expected data in body.innerText scrape — Question Bank tab did not show 'loan-loss' question text, Reportees tab did not show 'Sarah Mwangi', Submissions tab showed 'No submissions yet' even though the backend GET /api/contexts/{cid}/submissions returns Sarah's submission and at least one fresh submission I just created. Could be (a) tab content fetched on mount only and not refreshed when switching tabs, (b) the API call is bound to a different context_id than the active one, (c) responses stored on prior tabs are not visible after switch. Visual proof: screenshot of /app/cycle on Submissions tab shows the empty state card while the backend has live submissions for that context. Needs main-agent verification.

Public /respond/{token} page rendered only 2 textareas in my run, but the dispatched checklist had 4 questions. Could be: (a) only first N questions rendered, (b) layout uses one textarea for notes plus per-question textareas — count includes notes textarea so 1 question + 1 notes = 2 → underprovisioned. Form submit still produced a 'Thanks' state successfully so the submit path is wired. Worth confirming each question renders its own answer field.

action_items: INVESTIGATE Cycle page tab content rendering: confirm /app/cycle's Question Bank / Reportees / Submissions tabs are actually fetching from /api/contexts/{active_context_id}/{questions|reportees|submissions} when tab is switched — current behavior shows empty state in UI while backend has data. Try opening DevTools network tab on a fresh load and switching tabs to confirm GETs fire and responses are non-empty.

VERIFY RespondToChecklist renders one textarea per question (current observation: 2 textareas for a 4-question checklist) — submission still works but reportee likely cannot answer all questions individually.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/cycle.py L283-319 (_draft_questions_for_reportee) caps picked at top 6 but the cycle tests in the request specify '4-6 questions'. Current slice is `scored[:6]`. If ≤3 open questions exist (post-test with retired/answered ones), drafts may have <4 entries — generate would still succeed. Worth adding a min-questions guard or returning a skip reason 'fewer than 4 matched questions in bank'.

/app/backend/routers/cycle.py — `_executive_name` and the dispatch path call `db.accounts.find_one` twice (lines 279, 452). Coalesce into a single query to save a round-trip and improve dispatch latency on big batches.
/app/backend/routers/blog.py L196 `body[:18000]` truncates without warning. If LLM produces a longer article, the tail is silently lost. Consider a 'truncated' flag or a hard error for compose.

/app/backend/routers/cycle.py — `SubmissionIn.answers: List[Dict[str,Any]]` is unconstrained; accepts any shape. Should enforce a per-answer Pydantic model with `question_id: str` and `text: str` to prevent malformed submissions reaching the question-status flip loop.

Anti-spam check at cycle.py L342-346 uses `dispatched_at >= cutoff` against a stringified ISO timestamp — string comparison works for ISO-8601 BUT only because all values are zulu-suffixed identically; any timezone-offset variant in older records would compare wrong. Safer to store a numeric epoch alongside the iso string for index-friendly queries.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is rock-solid for iter18 — `pytest backend/tests/test_iter18_cycle_blog.py` should keep passing as a regression. Resend dispatch path returns real send_id values; do not be alarmed by emails to delivered@resend.dev — that is the sandbox always-deliver address. Anti-spam: any reportee dispatched within 14 days will be in skipped[] unless reportee_ids targets them — this is a feature. The single live concern is Cycle page tab CONTENT not visibly populating in the browser even though backend has data — please re-run with a clean session, open DevTools and confirm GETs fire when each tab is clicked. RespondToChecklist textarea count may be intentional (one per question + note) but my dispatched checklist had 4 questions and only 2 textareas rendered — worth confirming.
rca of the issue: Cycle tab content visibility — likely candidate is that the Cycle.jsx component fetches once on mount using activeContextId from auth/context store, and switching tabs only flips a local 'activeTab' state without re-fetching. If activeContextId is stale or not what the test expected (bramuel has 4 contexts; maybe activeContextId was reset to a non-Tuli one mid-render), the tabs would show empty data. Mitigation: in Cycle.jsx, key the data-fetch effect on both [activeTab, activeContextId] and ensure activeContextId is read from the same store the rest of /app uses. Direct verification: hit GET /api/contexts/06cc1fc6.../questions in browser devtools while on /app/cycle Bank tab — if it returns the bank data the bug is purely a render/binding bug; if it returns 403/404 the active-context wiring is wrong.
